message: You know that moment when the lights flicker and you think, "Uh oh, here we go again?" I’ve been there more times than I’d like to admit. I recently found a great resource that lays out what to do during a power outage, and it’s been a game changer for my family. Being prepared feels good, and knowing I have a plan in place makes those unexpected blackouts a little less daunting. What’s your go-to tip for getting through a power outage?
